LocalisableString.Content: You need to install the latest update to access Additional Content. To install the latest update, please close your application and relaunch it.

Once a specific part of the city has been wiretapped, enemies can be seen around corners and even through walls in Intel View. To see currently Wiretapped Rackets: Press #E_CTRL_MAP# to open the Map, then click Toggle Wiretap

Drop Explosives to destroy pursuing vehicles. To drop Explosives while driving: Press #E_CTRL_VEHICLE_WEAPON_GRENADE_AIM# To throw Explosives while driving: Hold #E_CTRL_VEHICLE_WEAPON_GRENADE_AIM# to aim Explosives, then release to throw

Once a specific part of the city has been wiretapped, enemies can be seen around corners and even through walls in Intel View. To see currently Wiretapped Rackets: Press #E_CTRL_MAP# to open the Map, then press #E_MA_LEFT_THUMB_CLICK#
Before making your decision, view possible Favors and upgrades from your Underboss by pressing the Left or Right Arrows. View past upgrades and Favors by pressing #E_MA_MAP_PLAYER#.

If using a controller, you can set Aim Assist to LOW, HIGH, or turn it OFF. To set Aim Assist, press #E_CTRL_MAP#, navigate to the Options Menu, then select Controls.
